Short title and commencement

THE ANCIENT MONUMENTS PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
THE ANCIENT
MONUMENTS PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No.
XXXIII of 1962
[2nd June, 1962]
An Ordinance further to amend the Ancient Monuments Preser vation Act, 1904
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Ancient Monuments
Preservation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the twenty-third day of March,
1956.

Insertion of new section IA, Act VII of 1904

THE ANCIENT MONUMENTS PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
THE ANCIENT
MONUMENTS PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No.
XXXIII of 1962
[2nd June, 1962]
An Ordinance further to amend the Ancient Monuments Preser vation Act, 1904
2. Insertion of new section
IA, Act VII of 1904. In the Ancient Monuments Preservation Act, 1904,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, after section 1, the following new
section IA shall be inserted, namely:-
"1A. Declaration.-It
is hereby declared that the ancient monuments to which this Act relates are
ancient and historical monuments of national importance."

Validation, etc.

THE ANCIENT MONUMENTS PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
THE ANCIENT
MONUMENTS PRESERVATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No.
XXXIII of 1962
[2nd June, 1962]
An Ordinance further to amend the Ancient Monuments Preser vation Act, 1904
3. Validation, etc.
Anything done, action taken, rule made or notification issued under the said
Act on or after the twenty-third day of March, 1956, and before the
promulgation of this Ordinance, shall be deemed to have been done, taken, made
or issued under the said Act as amended by this Ordinance, and shall have, and shall
be deemed always to have had, effect accordingly.
